opportunity: kuna prints a pointer plus a constant byte offset as an integer round trip, *(T *)((long)p + K): two casts per access where IDA prints one (or none). The cast census measured 3,771 such casts on the 4,815 functions kuna and IDA share (IDA: 0), 99.8% with sizeof(T) dividing K. The ops are INT_ADD from the start (PTRSUB->INT_ADD demotion fires 0 times): a void * base has no field and no element size, so P5 builds neither PTRSUB nor PTRADD.
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-castarith.xml (12 assertions, pass 1 option castarith off, pass 2 on, pass 3 arraynotation off) + 23 unit tests (p9_emit/kuna_castarith/tests.rs) + compiled round trip decompile_all_cli.rs a_pointer_plus_whole_elements_round_trips_through_the_printed_c (fixture castarith_x86_64.c, 24 functions, gcc -O0 / clang -O0 / gcc -O2, option on and off)
inspiration: Hex-Rays never converts a pointer to an integer to add an offset: *((unsigned int *)a1 + 43), or a1[15] when the pointee already has the access width.

corpus_sweep.structural: 4 of 75,296 functions change control flow, all the same shape (a goto and its label gone, one more duplicated return marked // return-dupe) and all through taildup: its 12-printed-op return-tail budget counts CASTs and runs after the cast pass, so a tail the removed casts bring within budget is duplicated. kmod -O2-noinline sub_b200, rsyslogd -O2 sub_69b50, rsyslogd -O2-noinline sub_69570, libedit -O0 sub_1fe22; with --option taildup off both arms print the same gotos. taildup preserves the value by design (the copy runs on the one path that reached the goto). Documented in 09-emission.md, 08-structuring.md (taildup) and the option's catalog row.

soundness.construction: k * sizeof(T) == K exactly (K signed, divisibility required); base converted pointer to pointer; element size == access width; alignment unchanged
soundness.round_trip: 24 functions x (gcc -O0, clang -O0, gcc -O2) x (on, off): printed C recompiled and run prints exactly the binary's output in all 6 arms; includes a byte widened for a signed compare and a word widened for an index (castimplied through the subscript), an integer base (kept), and far_idx: 8/4/2-byte reads at indexes -2^31 and -(2^32-1) (kept: C reads 0x80000000..0xffffffff as unsigned int) and -(2^31-1), +2^31 (converted), through a 48 GiB MAP_NORESERVE map
refusals: sum read as an integer or assigned to a variable declared as an integer
store of a value whose defining op the pass has not cast unless the opcode fixes its kind
void * sum passed to a call or returned (calleevote would learn char *)
constant naming a global, or address-like beside an integer cast to a pointer (table[i])
soundness.bases: a variable declared as a pointer to T is used bare; an implied cast read only by the add is retargeted to T *; an implied cast other ops read too is left alone and the new (T *) cast reads its integer or pointer input (no cast stacked on a cast)
soundness.castimplied: castimplied reads a converted load's C type from the subscript's cast base, as it reads *(T *)p: (int)((unsigned char *)a0)[0x11], not (int)(unsigned int)(...); byte-identical with castarith off on 201 binaries
